'''Nico Felicien Declercq''' (born 27 December 1975) is a Belgian [[physicist]], [[mechanical engineer]], [[poet]], [[historian]] and [[philosopher]]. He is a [[professor]]<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.me.gatech.edu/news/woodruff-school-faculty-promotions-2022 |title=Five Woodruff School Faculty Awarded Promotions |publisher=Georgia Tech News |access-date=2022-04-05}}</ref> at the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]] in Atlanta and [[Georgia Tech Europe]] in France. He specializes in [[Nondestructive testing|ultrasonic nondestructive evaluation of materials]], propagation of ultrasonic waves in [[Materials science|highly complex materials]], in [[acoustics]], in theoretical and experimental linear and nonlinear [[ultrasonics]], [[Acousto-optic effect|acousto-optics]], [[Medical Physics|medical physics]] and [[Acoustic Microscopy|acoustic microscopy]]. He has investigated the acoustics of [[Chichen Itza]] and [[Epidaurus]].<ref>{{cite news| url=http://www.livescience.com/history/070405_greeks_acoustics.html| title=Mystery of Greek Amphitheater's Amazing Sound Finally Solved| first= Tom| last= Chao| publisher=LiveScience| date= 5 April 2007| access-date=2007-04-05}}</ref> He is also the author of a series of works on [[cosmology]],<ref name="Declercq2025_Cosmology">{{Cite journal |last=Declercq |first=Nico F. |date=2025 |title=Emergence of 4D Spacetime and Cosmic Expansion from Causal Geometry |journal=Zenodo Classification of Fundamental Particles in Trembling Spacetime |journal=Zenodo |doi=10.5281/zenodo.15830692 |doi-access=free }}</ref> [[general relativity]],<ref name="Declercq2025_TSRT">{{Cite == Education, career and awards ==
Declercq received his [[Bachelor of Sciences|BSc]] and [[Master of Science|MSc]] in physics (with a major in [[astrophysics]]) from the [[Katholieke Universiteit Leuven]] in 1996 and 2000, respectively, and received a [[Doctor of Philosophy|PhD]] in [[engineering physics]] from [[Ghent University]] in 2005. He worked as a Belgian National Science Foundation (FWO Vlaanderen) [[Postdoctoral research|postdoctoral fellow]] with Ghent University and has been a visiting scientist, supported by [[NATO]], at the National Center for Physical Acoustics at the [[University of Mississippi]], before joining Georgia Tech in 2006.

Declercq received the ''[[International Dennis Gabor Award]]'' from the [[NOVOFER Foundation]] of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]] on December 21, 2006. He received the ''[[ICA Early Career Award]]'' "For outstanding contributions to ultrasonics, particularly for studies of propagation and diffraction of acoustic waves" from the [[International Commission for Acoustics]] in 2007.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.icacommission.org/pastaward.html |title=ICA - Early Career Award - Past Recipients |publisher=International Commission for Acoustics |access-date=2014-05-28 |archive-date=2016-03-03 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303221736/http://www.icacommission.org/pastaward.html }}</ref>
In 2024, he received the ''[[C.V. Raman|Raman]]-[[Georges Charpak|Charpak Award]]'' from the [[France–India relations|Indo-French Centre for the Promotion of Advanced Research]], alongside collaborators from the [[University of Allahabad]].<ref>Ajit Kumar Maddheshiya (PhD student who benefitted from the Fellowship, enabling him to conduct research in Declercq's lab), Phool Singh Yadav, and [[Raja Ram Yadav]], Physics Department, [[University of Allahabad]]. The award (2023-RCF-IN-0067) is named after Nobel laureates [[C.V. Raman]] and [[Georges Charpak]] and is a joint initiative by the [[Government of India]], the French Embassy in India, and [[France–India relations|CEFIPRA]].</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.dailyexcelsior.com/raman-charpak-fellowship/ |title=Raman-Charpak fellowship |date=17 February 2024 |publisher=Daily Excelsior |access-date=2024-08-21}}</ref>

Declercq served as president (2013–2015) of the steering board of the ''International Congress on Ultrasonics'',<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.icultrasonics.org/ICU_Committee_Members.pdf |title=Members of ICU Board and of Young Scientist Advisory Committee YSAC |publisher=International Congress on Ultrasonics}}</ref> as well as president of their 2015 congress.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.me.gatech.edu/2015-ICU-Metz/ |title=Welcome message |publisher=2015 International Congress on Ultrasonics }}{{Dead link|date=November 2023 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref> He is an [[associate editor]] of the journal ''Acta Acustica united with Acustica'',<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.acta-acustica-united-with-acustica.com/journal-information/editorial-board.html#c20 |title=Editorial Board |publisher=Acta Acustica united with Acustica |access-date=2014-05-28 |archive-date=2014-06-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140602070420/http://www.acta-acustica-united-with-acustica.com/journal-information/editorial-board.html#c20 |url-status=dead }}</ref> associate editor of the ''[[Journal of Nondestructive Evaluation]]'',<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.springer.com/materials/mechanics/journal/10921?detailsPage=editorialBoard |title=Editorial Board |publisher=Springer's Journal on Nondestructive Evaluation |access-date=2015-05-14}}</ref> and founding [[editor-in-chief]] of [[Elsevier]]'s ''Physics in Medicine''.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.journals.elsevier.com/physics-in-medicine/editorial-board/ |title=Editorial Board |publisher=Elsevier |work=Physics in Medicine |access-date=2014-07-22}}</ref> He serves on technical committees of the ''French Acoustical Society'' and is the Chair of the Ultrasonics Technical Committee of the ''European Acoustics Association''.<ref>{{cite web | url=http://euracoustics.org |title=Website of the ''European Acoustics Association'' |access-date=2018-07-11}}</ref>
Declercq has received several ''Teaching Excellence Awards''.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://ctl.gatech.edu/content/student-recognition-excellence-teaching-class-1934-honor-roll |title=Website of the ''Student recognition excellence in teaching, Class 1934 Honor Roll'' |access-date=2023-02-26}}</ref>
In addition to his tenure as a [[full professor]] at [[Georgia Tech]], he serves in a courtesy role as a [[full professor]] in the Doctoral School of the [[University of Lorraine]] in [[France]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.univ-lorraine.fr/recherche-et-innovation/ecoles-doctorales/ |title=Website of the Doctoral School of the University of Lorraine (in French) |access-date=2023-10-24}}</ref>

== Professional Connections with France ==
Declercq is a [[Full Professor]] at the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]] in [[Atlanta]] and serves on doctoral committees worldwide,<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.kuleuven.be/doctoraatsverdediging/fiches/3E06/3E060811.htm |title=A PhD Committee at The Catholic University of Leuven|access-date=2024-09-01}}</ref> including [[France]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://scanr.enseignementsup-recherche.gouv.fr/person/idref182510077 |title=Jury Contributions in France|access-date=2024-09-01}}</ref> Beyond his primary academic responsibilities, he advises PhD students at the [[Doctoral school|Doctoral Schools]] of [[Arts et Métiers ParisTech|''École Nationale Supérieure des Arts et Métiers'']]<ref>{{cite thesis | url=http://www.theses.fr/2021HESAE071|title=A PhD Thesis at École Nationale Supérieure des Arts et Métiers|date=25 November 2021 |publisher=Paris, HESAM |access-date=2024-09-01 |last1=Miqoi |first1=Nada |last2=Meraghni |first2=Fodil }}</ref> and [[University of Lorraine|''Université de Lorraine'']] in [[France]].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.univ-lorraine.fr/recherche-et-innovation/ecoles-doctorales/  |title=The Doctoral School of the University of Lorraine|access-date=2024-09-01}}</ref> Moreover, in France, Declercq has mentored PhD students even in cases where administrative constraints prevented his formal recognition as primary advisor.<ref>{{cite thesis | url=https://theses.hal.science/tel-04069781/ |title=Co-advisor, PhD of Othmane-Latif Ouabi, with C. Pradalier and M. Geist.|date=10 October 2022 |publisher=Université de Lorraine |access-date=2024-09-01 |last1=Ouabi |first1=Othmane-Latif }}</ref>
His academic involvement in [[France]] includes serving on [[Habilitation]] and [[Doctor of Philosophy|Doctoral Committees]] at prestigious institutions such as [[Sorbonne University|''Sorbonne Université'']],<ref>Slah Yaacoubi, "Process and Structural Health Monitoring: Development of Tailored Solutions Based on Artificial Intelligence," Habilitation à diriger des recherches (HDR), Sorbonne University, 12 May 2023. Jury members: Didem Ozevin, Nazih Mechbal, Babak Nahidmobarakeh, Alain Bernard, Yoshinori Hirata, Quentin Grimal, Nico F. Declercq.</ref> the [[University of Lille|''Université de Lille'']],<ref>{{cite web | url=https://lilloa.univ-lille.fr/handle/20.500.12210/44303 |title=Lille, Open Archive|date=19 December 2008 |access-date=2024-09-01 |last1=Benaissa |first1=Hichem }}</ref> the [[University of Franche-Comté|''Université de Franche-Comté'']], the [[Le Mans University|''Université du Maine'']],<ref>{{cite thesis | url=https://theses.fr/2018LORR0139 |title=A PhD Committee at Le Mans in France|date=25 October 2018 |publisher=Université de Lorraine |access-date=2024-09-01 |last1=Qi |first1=Shuibao |last2=Assouar |first2=Mohamed Badreddine }}</ref> and the [[Polytechnic University of Hauts-de-France|''Université Polytechnique Hauts-de-France'']].<ref>{{cite web | url=https://lilloa.univ-lille.fr/handle/20.500.12210/80891 |title=Contribution au CND et contrôle santé de structures par des techniques à faibles ressources, Habilitation à diriger des recherches|date=22 September 2022 |access-date=2024-09-01 |last1=Chehami |first1=Lynda }}</ref> He has also held various positions at multiple levels within the ''Société Française d'Acoustique''.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://sfa.asso.fr/ |title=The French Acoustical Society|access-date=2024-09-01}}</ref> In addition, Declercq leads an ultrasonics laboratory<ref>Laboratory for Ultrasonic Nondestructive Evaluation, International Research Laboratory IRL 2958 Georgia Tech – CNRS</ref> at [[Georgia Tech Europe]], which operates within the [[French National Centre for Scientific Research|French National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS)]].
